画像生成プロンプト全文:
Create exactly one square (1:1) full-color anime-style cel-shaded illustration for a public evaluation dataset. A single gigantic original industrial-military robot stands alone in a spacious hangar, shown as a full-body view from head to feet with the entire machine clearly inside the frame. The robot is deliberately and unmistakably asymmetrical: one side has a bulky tracked construction arm with exposed hydraulic cylinders and a shovel-like articulated attachment; the other side has a different narrower armored manipulator and a distinctly different shoulder-mounted industrial equipment module. Combine heavy construction machinery details (hydraulic pistons, excavator-like joints, crawler components, rugged mechanical linkages) with military-inspired features (angular armor plates, olive drab and muted camouflage-like paint blocks, utilitarian weathering), but do not include any writing, lettering, logos, symbols, numbers, insignia, or stencil text anywhere. The head is an original non-humanoid sensor housing with no expressive face, no eyes arranged like a human face, and no resemblance to robots or characters from any existing anime, game, film, or franchise. Hangar background has dramatic overhead lights, structural beams, maintenance platforms and machinery only; no people, no human silhouettes, no figures, no crew. Crisp clean cel shading, original mecha design, dramatic but readable lighting, full color. Absolute exclusions: people, human silhouettes, faces, text, letters, logos, numbers, watermarks, existing franchise character likenesses.
